purpose: Close the remaining should/nit findings from the release PR reviews so every PR issue is resolved.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-11 the owner instructed in the controlling session: "do all. complete all work. merge to main. clean worktrees. tell me when all issues in PR's are resolved." This campaign repairs the remaining non-owner should/nit findings recorded in the independent review comments of Dyk PRs #491, #494, #496, #498, #499, #501 and #504. Owner-reserved items (#21 message-to-task link, #16 rebuild lock, J9 member deadline editing) are excluded. Bounded repairs under Dyk AGENTS.md section 4; visible changes are represented in Storybook and independently reviewed before merge. PRs only, never merge or deploy; no production access. No limits; provider subscription limits and the no-progress guard are the stops. Provider order Claude, Codex, Cursor.

constraints: No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions, paid services, or Playwright and other browser-driven tests (Dyk owner rule). Local disposable SQL only through the repository runners (npm run test:sql / npm run journeys with a selected scope) when a task changes a route or persistence; never the production database.

Keep the affected Storybook stories in sync with every renderer change (Storybook is not post-hoc documentation). RU/EN/HE, true Hebrew RTL, 320/390 widths, 44px hit areas, no horizontal overflow, truthful states (T2).
Never read .env contents, credentials, private conversations or real user data; fixtures are synthetic.
A Storybook build or passing tests is not visual acceptance; each PR lists the story ids for independent visual review and states that the visual verdict is pending.

Do not remove worktrees, delete branches or link another checkout's node_modules. Do not add any new blocking gate, lock, required approval or check that depends on owner-provisioned keys, credentials or setup (Dyk AGENTS.md section 4).
Never weaken an existing test, guard or assertion; never add a capability outside the accepted feature map unless the task names the owner decision that adds it.
Do not edit app/src/task-board-ui.js or app/src/telegram-delivery-ui.js copy: open PR #500 owns that copy.

tasks.title: UI follow-ups from the release PR reviews
tasks.outcome: The remaining visual and wording findings from the PR reviews are fixed in RU/EN/HE.
tasks.goal: Read the independent review comments on Dyk PRs #498, #501, #496 and #494 (gh pr view <n> --repo netbka/Dyk --comments). Fix: (1) design-master--plan-limit at 320: group each chat name with its "Leave this one out" button so it is clear which chat a button belongs to, and make the "Left out on your plan" status chip not look like a button (#498); (2) EN "and 77 chats more" wording (moreChats wraps chatCount) and RU "Нет, это про: Каталина" phrasing (#498); (3) production completed-overview disabled state at RU 320: "Нужно подключить заново" squeezed into an ~87px column; let the status/hint use full width as the design rows now do (#501); (4) the production first Setup step is titled "Чаты" while its lead says "Источники": make naming consistent with the Sources tab (#501); (5) the production person chip in app/public/people-view.js can leave the x alone on a line at RU 390 in production-chats--list: keep Confirm and x together as the design chip does (#496); (6) the review-manifest notices renderer note still names parent-ui shell notices (#494).
acceptance: Each item is fixed or reported not applicable with evidence; affected focused tests, npm run check:ui and npm run storybook:build plus the storybook node tests pass, with exact commands; the PR lists story ids for visual review.

tasks.title: Test, tooling and data-retention follow-ups from the release PR reviews
tasks.outcome: Hollow or stale checks are made real, asset caching is safe, and the task-outcome counter has a defined retention.
tasks.goal: Read the review comments on Dyk PRs #491, #494, #499 and #504. Fix: (1) app/scripts/check-approved-design.js still expects the removed Settings sheet; update it to the current Profile (do not run it: it is a Playwright script, owner rule); (2) the assistant-connection test helper renderApp ignores its memberships argument, so a negative check tests nothing; make it honor memberships and keep the check meaningful (#504); (3) nothing checks that an asset ?v= version changes when its content changes (#491): add a guard or derive versions from content so stale cached assets cannot ship; (4) the manifest-experience from-source story id check ignores a meta id or parameters.__id (#491): add the one-line assertion; (5) #499 S2: FtTaskOutcomeCounts rows never expire; propose and implement a retention period for these pseudonymous daily counts with automated expiry and the privacy-impact review that docs/PRIVACY_SECURITY.md:70 requires, choosing a period that keeps the #486 re-measure possible. If PRINCIPLES or PRIVACY_SECURITY classify setting retention as owner-reserved, stop that item and report the exact clause with a recommended period instead.
acceptance: Each item is fixed or reported with evidence; every new or changed check fails when its guarded behavior is broken (show the mutation); affected tests, test:sql for the retention change, check:architecture and audit-principles pass, with exact commands.
